digest.component_or_area: Ruff linter configuration and timezone handling
propositions: Ruff ASYNC and DTZ rule families must be enabled in the global configuration and pass zero-diagnostic gates across src/rebar and tests.
Timestamp validation in validate_checks.py must explicitly use datetime.timezone.utc for both integer epoch and timezone-less persisted strings to ensure deterministic UTC clustering.
Security-pin cadence determination in security_pin.py must obtain an aware current instant with explicit tz argument, convert to host timezone, and extract the local calendar date.
Test coverage must prove timezone-invariant behavior under multiple TZ environment values on POSIX/macOS platforms via time.tzset().
All production code under src/rebar must use datetime.timezone.utc and prohibit the datetime.UTC token (incompatible with py310 target-version).
Ruff security selector S and Semgrep configuration files must be absent from the codebase.
